lesson: [lfm3_1.7b] Best recipe: run attribution_scan on ONE layer (it returns at most 20 units per skill), ablate that 20-unit set, then grow it to 64-256 units by cosine of gate (w1) rows plus down (w2*post_ffn_norm) columns to the seed mean. Examples that passed: L18 roman 64/256 units (drop .70, control -.01), L14 month 64/128/256 (.45-.49), L19 colour 64 (.44, control .10), L17 roman 128 (.49). Seed sets whose gate self-similarity was about .3-.5 grew well. Growth diluted the effect at L4 (.55 to .02), L22/L23 (.51/.31 to .15) and L12/L13 month (.34/.32 to .20, failed held-out).

[lfm3_1.7b] Output-alignment alone did not predict causal parts. The top-64 L17-L23 columns by cosine to month/weekday/colour/digit/country embedding directions (lead units .40-.61, e.g. L20 January writer .46, L23 digit writer .61) each dropped their target by <.07. Activation-selective units (L17 unit 98 at 31x for weekday) dropped it by <.02. The weights were useful for labelling attribution-found sets, e.g. the L19 roman seed-mean lens is III/II/IV/IX and the L16 month seed lens is November/January.

[lfm3_1.7b] Whole blocks and early attention groups are never selective. Every single-layer block from L15 to L22 dropped facts by .59-.67 and general_text by .18-.63, and facts (base .083) is the usual blocker. Ablating 4-5 heads at L6, L10 or L14 dropped most skills by .3-1.0. Late head groups can pass but only narrowly: L20 heads [3,7,10,11] for roman (.394) passed while random 4-head sets reached .375/.312, and the comparative group L20 [1,2,7,13] (.232) failed against random (.28).

[lfm3_1.7b] Broad skills did not localize. Late MLP clusters of 64-128 units for code (L22/L23 'return' and type writers), math (L23 3-digit writers), multilingual (L23 '?' writers) and geography (L15-L17 continent writers) all dropped their target by <.1. weekday_successor shared units with month in every layer (e.g. L9 weekday .40 vs month .23; L3 weekday .68 vs month .52), so no weekday part passed.

[lfm3_1.7b] Narrow skills form chains with a usable 20-unit attribution set at nearly every layer. Roman numerals passed at every layer L4-L23 except L16; month at L5, L6, L8, L9 and L12-L16 plus L19. Early-layer sets are strong (L5 month .62, L4 roman .55, L8 month .40). Check the target's matched control before screening: failures came from a control move above target/3 (L9 roman 128: .088 vs a .077 limit) or from held-out failure when the search drop was below about .30.
